class.name: PCKPackageEntry

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the entry is a delta patch of a file in an earlier pack.
If [code]true[/code], the file data is encrypted.
The MD5 sum of the file data as a hexadecimal [String].
The position of the data in the pack file at [member PCKPackage.pack_path], or [code]0[/code] for pending entries.
The path of the file, with [code]res://[/code].
If [code]true[/code], the entry is not in the pack file at [member PCKPackage.pack_path]: it was added in memory, or it is part of a pack description.
If [code]true[/code], the entry is a removal entry (see [method PCKPackage.add_removal]): when the pack is mounted, [member path] disappears from [code]res://[/code].
The size of the file data in bytes (before encryption), or [code]0[/code] while it is not known.

Where the data comes from: the source file for [constant PCKPackage.SOURCE_FILE], the path in the pack with [code]res://[/code] for [constant PCKPackage.SOURCE_PACK], or an empty [String] for data in memory and removal entries.
Where the data comes from, one of the [enum PCKPackage.SourceType] constants.
